**1 — Scene:** A mixed meal with cheese-and-tomato pizza, leafy salad, a little penne pasta, broccoli, cherry tomatoes and black olives.

**2 — Vessel:** A large, rounded-square dinner plate, approximately 26–28 cm across. Using a 27 cm equivalent diameter gives an estimated area of **572 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Pizza with melted cheese and tomato sauce; mixed salad leaves; penne; broccoli; cherry tomatoes; black olives; a light visible oil/dressing sheen. Pizza toppings are included in the pizza estimate.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:** Heights describe the outer envelope of each pile; bulk density is applied only once.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = volume | Density → grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cheese-and-tomato pizza | 27% | 154 × 1.3 = 200 ml | 0.95 → 190 g | 270 | 513 |
| Mixed salad leaves | 20% | 114 × 2 = 228 ml | 0.15 → 34 g | 20 | 7 |
| Cooked penne | 5% | 29 × 1 = 29 ml | 0.8 → 23 g | 155 | 36 |
| Broccoli | 9% | 51 × 2 = 102 ml | 0.6 → 61 g | 35 | 21 |
| Cherry tomatoes | 9% | 51 × 2.3 = 117 ml | 0.6 → 70 g | 20 | 14 |
| Black olives | 1% | 6 × 1.5 = 9 ml | 0.65 → 6 g | 115 | 7 |
| Oil/light dressing | Overlay* | About 4 ml | 1.0 → 4 g | 880 | 35 |

Food footprints total **71%** of the plate, consistent with the visible empty central and edge areas. *Dressing coats the food rather than occupying a separate footprint; its amount is especially uncertain.*

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **388 g and 633 kcal** is plausible for the visible pizza portion and modest vegetable sides. The small pasta portion contributes only about 23 g. Pizza thickness and oil quantity are the main uncertainties.
